headline: Indian equity markets rally sharply with Sensex surging over 2,000 points and Nifty topping 25,900 on strong FII inflows.

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: Strong foreign institutional investor (FII) buying backed the sharp market gains.
Lower crude oil prices helped boost overall investor sentiment.
Heavy buying in FMCG and private banking stocks led the benchmark index surge.
November market gains helped Indian indices recoup nearly all losses incurred in 2026.
whatHappening: Sensex jumped over 2,000 points while Nifty 50 breached the 25,900 mark.
Noel Tata pushed for restructuring and requested a revision of the Tata Sons board agenda.
Tata Steel CEO addressed stakeholder concerns regarding the APL Apollo deal.
India rejected US claims of structural excess capacity in a Section 301 probe response.
summary:
Indian benchmark indices staged a massive rally as Sensex jumped over 2,000 points and Nifty 50 surpassed 25,900 levels.
The rally was primarily propelled by strong foreign institutional inflows, lower crude oil prices, and solid gains in private banks and FMCG stocks.
Key individual stocks in news include Tata Steel, APL Apollo, Wipro, Lupin, PNB, and Acme Solar.
